record.question: Which of the following is an example of passive immunity?
options: Transfer of antibodies from mother to fetus
record.explanation: Answer C: Transfer of antibodies from mother to fetus. Maternal IgG transferred across the placenta is naturally acquired passive immunity: the recipient receives antibodies made by another person. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/pinkbook/hcp/table-of-contents/chapter-1-principles-of-vaccination.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
